senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; עמם to press, crowd, join) gathering, crowd, people.
units: Men. 53ᵇ יבא זח … לעם זו let ‘this one’ (Moses) come and receive ‘this’ (the Law) … for ‘this people’ (Israel); a. fr.—עם הארץ, v. אֶרֶץ.—Pl. עַמִּים gentiles.
<cite ref="Shabbat 14b">Sabb. 14ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>על ארץ הע׳</he> concerning (importations from) heathen countries. Y. Shebi. VI, 36ᵇ bot.; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="P00905"><he>עֲמָם</he></cite>.
